requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Address the agency receives written record requests at
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Address the agency receives written record requests at
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no committed record holds the address of any particular Colorado law-enforcement agency
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the postal address that agency's records unit receives written record requests at - ask its records unit if the arrest paperwork does not print it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the agency that made the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the agency that made the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which agency made an arrest is a fact of the participant's own record and no committed record holds it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the law-enforcement agency that arrested you, copied from your arrest paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest, copied exactly from the arrest paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case or incident number of the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case or incident number of the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no record identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case or incident number the agency recorded the arrest under, from the arrest paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identifiers the arrest was recorded under
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identifiers the arrest was recorded under
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what identifiers an arrest was recorded under lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and any other identifiers printed on the arrest record - these are what the agency will search on

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What shows no charges were filed, and where it is recorded
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What shows no charges were filed, and where it is recorded
requiredBeforeFiling.why: whether charges were filed on a particular arrest lives on records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what shows that no charges were filed arising from this arrest, and where that is recorded - the district attorney's office for that judicial district, or the court, if one was involved

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and any description of the person I believe I was mistaken for
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and any description of the person I believe I was mistaken for
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the identity of another person is not a fact the platform holds
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and any description of the person you believe you were mistaken for, if you know it; write that you do not know if you do not

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what the arrest paperwork says you were arrested for, copied from it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Why the arrest was of the wrong person, and what I am attaching
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Why the arrest was of the wrong person, and what I am attaching
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this is the participant's own account and the platform neither holds it nor writes it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own account of why the person arrested was not you, and a list of what you are attaching to show it - this is the substance the agency decides on

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the requester on this request
protectedBlanks.why: the requester signs the request personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the requester's signature on this request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
